description: Rural Point of Contacts is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Administrative", published or maintained by ROUTES Initiative. This dataset combines contact information for the regional/district offices across the Department's operating administrations (OAs). The intent of this dataset is to allow stakeholders to easily identify and contact appropriate offices. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Administrative". It has 17 columns, among them geo_ref1, Point of Contact, OA, Business Hours, EMAIL, FAX. The portal shows 2021-10-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: ROUTES Initiative. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
